facts.answer: Even when Form has no `fields` rules configured, it must still include the browser's HTML5 validity in the boolean result of `validate form`. Native constraints come from actual form controls; controls are not required to have name/id. Among controls with the same name, any applicable native invalid value must make the overall validation fail. Exceptions for novalidate and disabled still follow their respective contracts.
